name: MiniMax-H3 video with audio on two B70 cards

library.variant: AdaLN-fitted BF16 denoiser; INT8 ConvRot encoder
library.summary: Owner-approved AdaLN-fitted variant; one receipted eight-clip batch: 3173 seconds total, 396.625 seconds per clip. Exact scheduling against its own reference. Reconstruction incomplete.
library.public_summary: Make independent video clips with stereo sound on two cards. Eight clips took 396.6 seconds each on average. Rebuilding the chosen fitted weights from the official download is still unresolved.
library.public_caveat: AdaLN tables are a fitted approximation measured below the BF16 noise floor; all other denoiser weights are bit-exact with the official checkpoint. Exact scheduling against its own reference: 32 MATCH / 0 DIFFERS, 8 repeat passes. The 800.8 s/clip comparison is a ledger-recorded baseline, raw receipts not retained. No official-model parity claim.

library.benchmark_status: Owner-approved measured batch; strict headline certification pending: historical input binding and independent full-suite repeats are incomplete.
